findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: Observed there was sausages on the roller grill but there was not a Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM) present during the inspection. Ensure there is always a CFPM present during food preparation by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed the glass portions on the slushy machine around the nozzles have an accumulation of soil residues underneath. The glass portions should be removed to facilitate cleaning. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned at a frequency necessary to avoid the accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Ensure that the slushy machine is clean to sight and touch by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: THIS IS A THREE TIMES REPEAT VIOLATION: Observed the triple sink is not sealed to the wall. Surfaces subject to food/water must be smooth, non-absorbent and easily cleanable to prevent hard-to-reach areas from becoming soiled. Ensure that the triple sink is sealed to the wall by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: THIS IS A FIRST REPEAT VIOLATION: Observed there are drink spills and general refuse (soda bag caps, cardboard pieces, and dirt) accumulated on the floor underneath the soda machine boxes in the back storage area. Physical facilities must be cleaned at a frequency necessary to avoid the accumulation of soil residues. Ensure that the floor is cleaned to sight and touch by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed an object was removed from the wall above the back storage room hand washing sink leaving behind several holes and a soft foam material stuck to the wall. The holes must be sealed and the soft foam material removed to make a smooth, easily cleanable surface by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION FROM PREVIOUS INSPECTIONS DATED 12/11/2023, 9/13/2022, and 12/09/2021. 
The floor between soda fountain and slushy machine counters is soiled with refuse, residue, and debris. All nonfood-contact surfaces are required to be cleaned often enough to prevent the accumulation of residue/debris. Ensure that cleaning of these areas is occurring as required. Due to the amount of repeat violations the inspector will follow-up again to ensure the area has been cleaned.

4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Observed the back hand washing sink did not have any paper towels available. The PIC supplied paper towels at the hand sink during the inspection. Ensure there is always paper towels available at every hand washing sink.

6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION FROM THE 12/11/2023 INSPECTION. 

Observed the back hand washing sink was blocked with a bucket and rag during the inspection. The PIC removed the items from the hand sink during the inspection. Ensure that hand washing sinks remain accessible at all times.

5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Observed the back hand washing sink did not have soap available. The PIC provided soap to the hand sink during the inspection. Ensure there is always soap available at every hand washing sink. 

6-301.11: Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
Observed the customer microwave was heavily soiled with food debris. The microwave posed a risk of contaminating customer foods. The PIC cleaned the microwave during the inspection. Ensure the microwave remains clean to sight and touch to avoid cross contamination. 

3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed a knife stored behind the faucet of the triple sink. Storing the knife in this position presents a risk of dirty dishes or water splashes contaminating the clean knife. The knife was removed from this position during the inspection. Ensure that food contact surfaces remain clean to sight and touch. 

4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment:
THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION FROM THE 12/11/2023 INSPECTION. 

Observed a previously wet wiping cloth stored in an empty bucket. Wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizer between uses and once soiled immediately separated for laundering. Wet cloths are not allowed to sit in empty buckets or other surfaces within the facility when not in use. Ensure that wiping cloths are stored properly by the next routine inspection. 

3-304.14: (A) Cloths in-use for wiping FOOD spills for TABLEWARE and carryout containers shall be dry and used for no other purpose. (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be held between uses in chemical sanitizer at proper solution and laundered daily. (C) Cloths in-use for wiping raw animal FOOD surfaces shall be separate from other cloths. (D) Dry wiping cloths and sanitizing solution shall be free of FOOD debris and other soil. (E) Containers of sanitizing solution shall be stored off floor and used in manner to prevent contamination. (F) SINGLE-USE disposable sanitizer wipes shall be used in accordance with EPA labels.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION FROM THE 12/11/2023 INSPECTION

The soda counter and slushy counter are separated by approximately one-inch space insufficient to permit cleaning and not sealed to prevent soda and other items from accumulating between the counters. This space must be bridged/sealed to create surfaces which are smooth, non-absorbent and easily cleanable and facilitate the cleaning of such items. Ensure that this area is bridged or otherwise sealed to prevent accumulation of residue and debris between the counters. 

4-202.16: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be free of unnecessary ledges, projections, and crevices, and designed and constructed to allow easy cleaning and to facilitate maintenance.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION FROM PREVIOUS INSPECTIONS DATED 12/11/2023, 9/13/2022, and 12/09/2021. 

The floor between soda fountain and slushy machine counters is soiled with refuse, residue, and debris. All nonfood-contact surfaces are required to be cleaned often enough to prevent the accumulation of residue/debris. Ensure that cleaning of these areas is occurring as required. Due to the amount of repeat violations the inspector will follow-up in two weeks (10/16/2024) to ensure the area has been cleaned.

4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the following non-food contact surfaces need to be cleaned:
(1) Food debris in the drawer storing clean pans at the front cashier area. 
(2) Food debris in the freezer underneath the counter at the front cashier area. 
(3) An accumulation of soil on the nozzles and surrounding area by the nozzles at the iced coffee, creamer, cappuccino, and coffee machines. 
(4) Molded and soiled shelves holding drinks in the back walk-in drink cooler.

Ensure the following non-food contact surfaces are cleaned by the next routine inspection. 

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION FROM PREVIOUS INSPECTIONS DATED 12/11/2023 and 12/08/2021. 

Inspector observed mop heads stored on the base of the mop sink. Mops must be stored in a manner which prevents contamination and facilitates air drying. Mops may be stored in the top portion of the mop bucket and/or hanging inverted along the wall. Ensure that mops are stored properly by the next routine inspection. 

6-501.113: Maintenance tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners, and similar items shall be: (A) Stored so they do not contaminate FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES; and (B) Stored in an orderly manner that facilitates cleaning the area used for storing the maintenance tools.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION FROM PREVIOUS INSPECTIONS DATED 12/11/2023 and 9/13/2022.

Caulking has not been completed on the back of the triple sink as cited during the previous inspection. Surfaces subject to food/water must be smooth, non-absorbent, and easily cleanable to prevent hard-to-reach areas from becoming soiled. Ensure that all surfaces subject to food/water are SMOOTH, NON-ABSORBENT, AND EASILY CLEANABLE by the next routine inspection. 

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed there is a large amount of soda spills and garbage underneath the soda machine boxes in the back room. The soda spills and garbage must be cleaned by the next routine inspection. Ensure that physical facilities are cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. 

6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.
